__**All**__ value_strings must end with {0, NULL}. Why do I have to repeat that over and over again?
With an incorrect value option_len will roll over to a large value, causing infinite loops.

> breaking while loop once the option_len reaches 0 or below that.

It's an **unsigned** integer, therefore will never go below zero. Thus when option_len < 6 it will roll over.

What actually happens is undefined, but most cases the value will roll over to UINT8_MAX + option_len - 6
Has this code been fuzz-tested? If not, this probably will reveal infinite loops.
